notes: This file is a trimmed archive of the original n8n workflow preserved as a reference for the Auto-Enrol Direct Applications feature.
Key patterns adopted by lib/quickbooks/createDirectApplicationInvoice.ts and lib/quickbooks/resolveCustomerRef.ts:
1. Look up QB entities by single-field SELECT query (email for customer, DocNumber for invoice).
3. Route all calls through a centralized OAuth proxy (we use /api/quickbooks/proxy).
4. Keep Direct Application invoice line descriptions distinct from grant invoice keywords ('baseline', 'enhanced').
